verdict.rationale: Tavily is an API-first service that runs headlessly. It has REST endpoints for search, extract, crawl, map and research, plus official Python and JS SDKs. A `tvly` CLI covers search, extract, crawl and research, and automation-relevant behavior is documented: 429 responses with a retry-after header, production rate limits, usage and log endpoints, and async research status retrieval. Missing for 10: explicit CI/pipeline guidance (e.g. GitHub Actions examples or env-var key configuration), a published OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
